'''Kombat''' is a one-day duel tournament played '''Monday 9th August''', 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}} with entries for higher and lower divisions. 
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. 

Streamed by [http://www.twitch.tv/hemostick hemostick]

== Format ==
* Separated higher and lower divisions.
* Lower division start at 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}
* Higher division start at 22:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}
* Top players from lower division will move forward to higher division.
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}
